home.title: Home
home.vpnUnsupported: VPN not available on this device
home.emptyBody: Guardian is watching your apps. Activity will appear here when something is detected.

welcome.title: Welcome to Guardian
welcome.body: Guardian helps you understand what your apps are doing on the network — locally on your device, with no account required.

privacy.title: Your privacy comes first
privacy.body: We only record metadata like domain names and data sizes. We never read your messages, photos, or file contents. Everything stays on your phone unless you opt in to cloud sync.

monitoring.title: Enable network monitoring
monitoring.body: Guardian uses Android’s VPN permission to observe network connections. Tap below to grant permission and start protecting your device.

done.title: You’re all set
done.body: Guardian is now watching for unusual activity. You can review apps, alerts, and settings from the home screen.

appDetails.title: App Details
appDetails.trusted: You trust this app — alerts are less sensitive

permissions.title: Monitoring setup
permissions.heading: How Guardian watches for risks
permissions.explanation: Guardian needs your permission to observe network activity. We only record metadata — domain names and data sizes — never the contents of your messages or files.
permissions.vpnBody: Android shows a VPN key icon while Guardian is active. Normal internet stays direct, and only website-name lookups are recorded. Private DNS stays off, and Chrome secure DNS stays off.
permissions.notificationsBody: We'll notify you when something looks unusual. Safe activity stays silent; serious concerns appear immediately.
permissions.unsupported: Network monitoring is not available on this device.
permissions.simulatorNote: Demo mode uses simulated events — no VPN permission needed.
permissions.vpnDenied: VPN permission was denied. Tap Start monitoring again and choose OK in the Android dialog.
permissions.vpnRevoked: The system stopped monitoring. Guardian is trying to start it again. If this message stays, turn off any other VPN and tap Start monitoring.
permissions.vpnNoActivity: Could not open the permission dialog. Close and reopen the app, then try again.
permissions.vpnFailed: Could not start network monitoring. Restart the app and try again.
